exposure: Adherence to Institute of Medicine (IOM) weight gain recommendations
Women with excessive weight gain (excluded in a secondary analysis)
outcome: Twin birthweight < 10th percentile for gestational age
cohort: 252 overweight and obese women with twin pregnancies delivered >24 weeks by a single MFM practice between 2005 and 2017
finding: In overweight and obese women with twin pregnancies, meeting the IOM recommendations for weight gain during pregnancy was associated with improved pregnancy outcomes, including higher birth weights and reduced risk of preterm birth and premature rupture of membranes.
birth_weight: Reported for both twins (larger and smaller)
